command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "ACCEPTANCE_SOURCE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "HOST_LOAD";uptime
echo 'FULL_E2E'
LCL_E2E_PORT=5297 LCL_VISUAL_CONTRACT=1 pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/mobile/playwright.config.ts --workers=1 --reporter=json > /tmp/shelly-ionic-current-202-e2e.json 2>/tmp/shelly-ionic-current-202-e2e.err || {
echo E2E_FAILED
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('/tmp/shelly-ionic-current-202-e2e.json').read_text(errors='replace')
try:
 j=json.loads(s[s.find('{'):]);print('STATS',j.get('stats'))
 def walk(suites):
  for suite in suites:
   for spec in suite.get('specs',[]):
    for test in spec.get('tests',[]):
     if test.get('status') not in ('expected','skipped'):
      print('FAILED',spec.get('title'),test.get('status'))
      for r in test.get('results',[]):
       if r.get('error'):print('ERROR',str(r['error'].get('message',''))[:1500])
   walk(suite.get('suites',[]))
 walk(j.get('suites',[]))
except Exception as err:print('JSON_ERROR',str(err),s[-700:])
PY
tail -12 /tmp/shelly-ionic-current-202-e2e.err
exit 77
}
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
s=Path('/tmp/shelly-ionic-current-202-e2e.json').read_text(errors='replace')
j=json.loads(s[s.find('{'):]);n=j['stats']
print('E2E_STATS',n)
assert n['expected']==50 and n['unexpected']==0 and n['skipped']==0 and n['flaky']==0
PY
echo 'E2E_50_PASS'
echo 'FULL_CHECK'
pnpm check >/tmp/shelly-ionic-current-202-check.log 2>&1 || { echo CHECK_FAILED; tail -100 /tmp/shelly-ionic-current-202-check.log; exit 78; }
echo 'CHECK_PASS'
grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |Performance budget|Performance review|threshold exceeded|budget passed' /tmp/shelly-ionic-current-202-check.log | tail -46 || true
echo 'CAPACITOR_ANDROID'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android
SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"
printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$SDK" > apps/mobile/android/local.properties
(cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --quiet)
APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
test -s "$APK"
echo "APK_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK"|awk '{print $1}')"
echo "APK_BYTES=$(wc -c < "$APK"|tr -d ' ')"
echo 'WORKTREE'
git status --short
